definitions.title: The Kobold Trail
definitions.body: A kobold courier watches your warband pick through a broken supply crate. The deep wheel ruts and scattered machine fittings are fresh. 'We carried a humming load over the high pass,' the courier says. 'It is already gone from this camp.'

choices.label: Follow the wheel ruts
choices.response: The tracks confirm the Wrong Machine passed through the kobold camp, but the crate and its cargo have moved on. You follow the trail deeper into the Mountains.

definitions.prompt: What do you make of the kobold tracks?

definitions.title: The Archivist
definitions.body: At the pass, the Archivist steps from a page of ordered script. 'The Whim's goblins have returned,' the Archivist says to you. 'The Grand Library keeps dangerous possibilities from becoming disasters. I will not let your warband reclaim the Wrong Machine.'

choices.label: Ask where the Machine went
choices.response: 'The kobolds have already moved it beyond this pass,' the Archivist replies. 'You are following an absence.' The page folds shut before you can press for its destination.
